item.title: Viewport and canvas ontology
item.description: I need to learn about the structure of the game, things like camera → viewport → window. I don’t know what these constructs are and they get in my way when I do things like try to grab the root node of scene tree but get_tree().root isn’t the root node it’s a Window so that starts to confuse me.
